newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian CERA Bank status OK for KB merger -paper.
newsitem.headline: Belgian CERA Bank status OK for KB merger -paper.

text.p: The board of Belgian bank Kredietbank has concluded the cooperative structure of rival CERA bank would not be a barrier to a merger of the two, Belgian newspaper De Morgen reported on Tuesday.
A merger scenario will therefore be studied by Kredietbank in more depth, the paper said.
Belgian analysts have speculated that a Kredietbank/CERA bank merger would be a prelude to a cross-border alliance with the Netherlands' Rabobank, which is also cooperatively owned.
Rabobank said in June it could consider a joint venture with Kredietbank and CERA but ruled out the possibility of a full scale merger.
